intro.summary: Southwest inner-city community north of Marda Loop with a mix of older houses, new infills and low-rise condos close to 17 Avenue and Crowchild Trail.
intro.body: South Calgary covers the blocks north of Marda Loop, between Crowchild Trail and 14 Street SW. It mixes older detached houses with newer semi-detached infills, rowhouses and low-rise apartment buildings. Single-family infill still happens lot by lot on the quieter residential streets.
